short: Next-generation AMM with hooks, singleton architecture, and flash accounting
introduction: Uniswap V4 represents a fundamental redesign of the Uniswap protocol, introducing a singleton contract architecture where all pools live within a single PoolManager contract. The most significant innovation is the hooks system, which allows developers to attach custom logic at key points in the pool lifecycle (before/after swaps, position modifications, and pool creation). Flash accounting eliminates redundant token transfers by netting balances across operations.
designPurpose: Uniswap V4 was designed to make AMM pools endlessly customizable while dramatically reducing gas costs. The singleton pattern eliminates the need to deploy separate contracts per pool, saving deployment gas and enabling efficient multi-pool operations. Hooks unlock use cases like dynamic fees, TWAP-based limit orders, on-chain oracles, and custom LP reward schemes that were previously impossible within the Uniswap framework.
commonUsage: Developers build custom hooks to create specialized AMM pools with dynamic fees, MEV protection, or novel trading mechanisms. Traders benefit from lower gas costs due to the singleton architecture and flash accounting. Liquidity providers can participate in pools with custom reward structures and fee models defined by hook contracts.
fn.swap.desc: Executes a swap within a pool identified by its PoolKey. The PoolManager calls the pool's hook contract before and after the swap if hooks are registered.
fn.swap.params.key: The PoolKey struct identifying the pool (token0, token1, fee, tickSpacing, hook address).
fn.swap.params.params: The SwapParams struct containing zeroForOne direction, amountSpecified, and sqrtPriceLimitX96.
fn.swap.params.hookData: Arbitrary data passed to the hook contract's beforeSwap and afterSwap callbacks.
fn.swap.returns.delta: The BalanceDelta representing the net token amounts owed by or to the caller.
fn.modifyPosition.desc: Adds or removes liquidity from a pool within a specified tick range. Calls hook callbacks if registered.
fn.modifyPosition.params.key: The PoolKey struct identifying the pool.
fn.modifyPosition.params.tickLower: The lower tick boundary of the liquidity position.
fn.modifyPosition.params.tickUpper: The upper tick boundary of the liquidity position.
fn.modifyPosition.params.liquidityDelta: The amount of liquidity to add (positive) or remove (negative).
fn.modifyPosition.params.hookData: Arbitrary data passed to the hook contract's beforeModifyPosition and afterModifyPosition callbacks.
fn.modifyPosition.returns.delta: The BalanceDelta representing the net token amounts owed by or to the caller.
fn.initialize.desc: Creates and initializes a new pool with the given token pair, fee, tick spacing, hook, and initial price.
fn.initialize.params.key: The PoolKey struct defining the new pool's parameters including the hook contract address.
fn.initialize.params.sqrtPriceX96: The initial sqrt price of the pool in Q96 fixed-point format.
fn.initialize.params.hookData: Arbitrary data passed to the hook contract's beforeInitialize and afterInitialize callbacks.
fn.initialize.returns.tick: The initial tick corresponding to the set price.
fn.donate.desc: Donates tokens directly to in-range liquidity providers of a pool without performing a swap. Useful for hook-based fee redistribution.
fn.donate.params.key: The PoolKey struct identifying the pool to donate to.
fn.donate.params.amount0: The amount of token0 to donate.
fn.donate.params.amount1: The amount of token1 to donate.
fn.donate.params.hookData: Arbitrary data passed to the hook callbacks.
fn.donate.returns.delta: The BalanceDelta representing the amounts donated.
fn.beforeSwap.desc: Hook callback invoked by the PoolManager before a swap executes. Can modify swap behavior, apply dynamic fees, or enforce conditions.
fn.beforeSwap.params.sender: The address that initiated the swap.
fn.beforeSwap.params.key: The PoolKey of the pool being swapped in.
fn.beforeSwap.params.params: The SwapParams containing the swap direction and amounts.
fn.beforeSwap.params.hookData: Custom data passed from the original swap caller.
fn.beforeSwap.returns.selector: Must return the function selector to confirm successful execution.
fn.afterSwap.desc: Hook callback invoked by the PoolManager after a swap completes. Can perform post-swap actions like loyalty rewards, analytics, or rebates.
fn.afterSwap.params.sender: The address that initiated the swap.
fn.afterSwap.params.key: The PoolKey of the pool that was swapped in.
fn.afterSwap.params.params: The SwapParams containing the swap direction and amounts.
fn.afterSwap.params.delta: The BalanceDelta result from the swap execution.
fn.afterSwap.params.hookData: Custom data passed from the original swap caller.
fn.afterSwap.returns.selector: Must return the function selector to confirm successful execution.
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.name: Swap with Hook Lifecycle
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.desc: Simulates a complete swap through the V4 PoolManager, showing the hook lifecycle (before/after callbacks) and flash accounting settlement.
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.step.callPoolM: The trader initiates a swap via the PoolManager. A flash accounting lock is acquired to track all balance changes atomically.
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.step.beforeSwa: The PoolManager calls the hook contract's beforeSwap() callback, which can execute custom logic like dynamic fee calculation or TWAP checks.
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.step.executeSw: The pool state is updated with the swap. Flash accounting records the token deltas without actually transferring tokens yet.
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.step.afterSwap: The PoolManager calls the hook contract's afterSwap() callback for post-swap actions like loyalty points or fee redistribution.
sim.swapWithHookLifecycle.step.settleDel: All accumulated balance deltas are settled in a single batch. The trader pays input tokens and receives output tokens, minimizing total transfers.
sim.customHookExecution.name: Custom Hook Pool Setup
sim.customHookExecution.desc: Simulates initializing a new pool with a custom hook contract and providing liquidity, demonstrating the extensible architecture.
sim.customHookExecution.step.initializeP: A new pool is initialized with the custom hook contract. The PoolManager registers the hook and calls its beforeInitialize/afterInitialize callbacks.
sim.customHookExecution.step.modifyPosit: A liquidity provider adds concentrated liquidity to the new pool. Tokens are deposited and tracked via flash accounting.
sim.customHookExecution.step.hookCallbac: The hook contract executes its custom logic (e.g., applying dynamic fee tiers). Flash accounting deltas are resolved to zero.
compose.erc6909.role: The PoolManager singleton mints ERC-6909 claim tokens for balances kept inside it and burns them to pay later — cheaper than external ERC-20 transfers.
compose.erc20.role: Pool currencies are ERC-20 tokens custodied by the singleton PoolManager; frequent traders can leave them inside and settle with claims instead of transfers.
